text: 14h Are seaweed pods the future of packaging? Last week, the tiny hamlet of Nobottle, Northamptonshire (population: 30), became home to an innovation trial: ginger shots with, you guessed it, no bottle. We've teamed up with packaging pioneers Notpla to pilot plastic-free Ooho pods, made from biodegradable seaweed. The pods hold our ginger shots and can be swallowed whole, with no traditional bottle needed. To mark the occasion we invited local residents to become the first people in the world to try our "no bottle" ginger shots. It's a trial to explore how this technology could be used in the future, not just with ginger shots, but potentially across other drinks and packaging formats too. A huge thank you to the residents of Nobottle and our friends at Notpla for helping us bring this pilot to life. After all, where better to trial a product with no bottle than...
